_comment: Earn's browser tools. AutolaunchWeb.ToolManifest adds them to tool_manifest.json only while the site offers Earn (AUTOLAUNCH_EARN=true). A public tool's `request` is the HTTP request it makes: `path` with each {field} filled from its input, and `body` the input fields it posts.

tools.name: autolaunch_earn_products
tools.title: List the places to earn on USDC
tools.description: List every place Autolaunch offers to lend USDC on Base, each read from its market at a recent block, shared for up to ten seconds: its id, protocol, market and asset with the exact addresses of its pool, asset and market token; rate_now, the market's yearly rate at today's rate, before compounding (yearly_percent, cut to two decimals, and ray, the market's own figure in units of 10^27), which changes as borrowing changes; supplied, what is lent in all; available, what can be withdrawn right now; supply_cap in whole tokens and capacity, the most one deposit can be before that cap (both null when it has none; capacity 0 when it is full); status (open, frozen: withdrawals only, paused: nothing moves, or inactive); the block the figures were read at; and the risks in plain words. Every amount is in the asset's smallest units (USDC has 6 decimals). Reads only; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: autolaunch_earn_quote
tools.title: Preview an Earn deposit or withdrawal
tools.description: Preview a deposit or withdrawal on one Earn product for one of my person's own wallets, at the latest block, without its wallet calls: the amount it moves (for everything, the balance at this block; a little more interest lands with it), whether the wallet's USDC approval to the market already covers a deposit (approved; otherwise the steps begin with an exact approval), what would block it (blocked: market_inactive, market_paused, market_frozen, not_enough_usdc, over_supply_cap, over_balance or not_available_now, in code and words, the first that applies in that order of market, wallet, then the market's capacity or what is available), the wallet's balance in the market, its USDC and its allowance, and the block it was read at. A preview reserves nothing; the chain may change before a step is sent. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

product.description: The product's id exactly as autolaunch_earn_products lists it, such as aave-usdc.

amount.description: The amount in the asset's smallest units (USDC has 6 decimals, so 1000000 is 1 USDC). Leave it out only to withdraw everything.

everything.description: true to withdraw the whole balance as it stands when the step lands, interest included. Only for withdraw, and never with an amount.

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.

tools.name: autolaunch_earn_positions
tools.title: Read my Earn balances
tools.description: Read my person's balance in every Earn product, for the wallet they signed in with, at the latest block: for each product its balance in the market, interest included (position none or held), the wallet's own USDC and its allowance to the market, and the block it was read at. Every amount is in the asset's smallest units. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

tools.name: autolaunch_earn_prepare
tools.title: Prepare an Earn step
tools.description: Prepare the wallet steps for a deposit or withdrawal on one Earn product, for one of my person's own wallets: a deposit is an exact USDC approval to the market's pool (usdc_approval) then supply, crediting the wallet; a withdrawal is withdraw, sending the USDC to the wallet, with everything taking the whole balance as it stands when the step lands. Each step is to, data and value for the wallet to send in turn, its data ending with the site's Builder Code. The answer carries what the preview does (amount, approved, blocked, the wallet's figures and the block): blocked names a reason the chain's state at that block makes the step certain to fail, and the steps are still returned. Built from block N, a step may be stale by the time it is sent. The site only prepares: the wallet's own key signs and sends each step, and money moves only then. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.
